question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the corridor from Art Clinic, New York, NY to Stanford in New York Center, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.989774 40.739706)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
